summary:
We developed Into The Remnants, an interactive 3D web-storytelling app that blends NASA’s historic space artifacts with classic anime esthetics. The virtual trip through the solar system on the platform takes users to see iconic relics, including Apollo lunar landing stages on the moon, dormant rovers on Mars, and Voyager probes in deep space.

It solves the problem of capturing the imaginations of school-age space enthusiasts by turning the complicated history of aerospace into a fascinating story for kids. The project includes real-time mouse-tracking 3D models and dynamic chapter switching, transforming forgotten space hardware into timeless time capsules that will inspire the next generation of explorers to appreciate humanity’s lasting cosmic footprint.
details:
‘Into The Remnants’ is an interactive 3D web based story telling application that combines NASA artifacts with anime themes. The application was built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GSAP, THREE.js and Google . It features real time 3D physics, parallax tracking with the cursor and the ability to dynamically change the flavour and theme of the application.

This project can help users by providing a fun and informative way to learn about aerospace history. It aims to spark interest in space exploration. The creativity of this project shows through the combination of nostalgic anime storytelling and accurate telemetry.
